verdict.rationale: AutoGen's docs say the built-in AssistantAgent can use tools, and they show a one-line run call. That supports defining a tool-using agent with little code. The pack never shows how custom tools are defined or that they are typed, such as Python functions with type hints turned into schemas. Missing for 10: evidence of custom tool definition with typed parameters/schemas, a code sample showing agent-plus-tool definition in a few lines, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can define an agent with typed custom tools in a few lines of code

citations.quote: AssistantAgent is a built-in agent that uses a language model and has the ability to use tools.
